subject: Missing attachment - updated file
text:
Hi,

Sorry for the delay; I’ve just seen your note about the missing attachment. You were right, the second version did not include the revised schedule, and that likely made the update much harder to review than it should have been. I’m attaching the correct PDF now, along with the original figures so you can see the changes in one place.

I should also mention that the delay may be partly my fault. My earlier message used the wrong file link, so when you opened the thread it probably looked like the supporting pages had vanished. That was an avoidable mistake, and I’m sorry you had to point it out while dealing with the rest of your day. I know this is annoying when your inbox is already tight, and I do not want you chasing loose ends on my behalf.

If anything still looks incomplete, reply here and I’ll send the backup sheet straight away. I can also resend by noon if the current one still appears blank on your end. The file should be named clearly today, so it is easier to spot, and I can forward the notes from the earlier call if that helps clarify the timing. I appreciate your patience, and I’ll make sure the next update is checked twice before it goes out.

Best,
